articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
articles.snippet: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

articles.title: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
articles.snippet: Authorities froze over $2.7 billion in Binance hack proceeds, while the separate FaceStealer scam stole over $400 million in 18 months.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides below $70K amid thin liquidity, ETF outflows
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $70,000 as crypto sentiment hit its lowest level in more than four months, with analysts warning of institutional outflows, thinning liquidity and elevated leverage.

articles.title: Trump nominates Hester Peirce successor among SEC, CFTC picks
articles.snippet: The White House also named a former CFTC commissioner and two CLARITY Act veterans as nominees to fill vacancies at the SEC and CFTC.

articles.title: Crypto Laundering a 'Material Risk' for UK Ahead of FATF Review: RUSI
articles.snippet: Assessors visit in June 2027, months before full crypto rules take effect, leaving the UK to prove it can enforce against crypto laundering.
